LOGIN.TITLE: Login
LOGIN.SUBTITLE: Sign in to Debrid Media Downloader.

ERRORS.UNEXPECTED: Could not sign in right now. Please try again.

LOGIN.REGISTERED: Account created. Sign in to set up Debrid Media Downloader.
LOGIN.REGISTRATION_CLOSED: An account has already been created. Sign in with its credentials.

REGISTER.TITLE: Create account
REGISTER.SUBTITLE: Create your administrator account to get started.
REGISTER.USERNAME_HELP: Use a username with 3 to 64 characters.
REGISTER.PASSWORD_HELP: Use at least 6 characters, up to 72 UTF-8 bytes. Accented characters and emoji can use more than one byte.
REGISTER.INVALID_REQUEST: Check the username and password requirements.
REGISTER.UNEXPECTED: Could not create the account right now. Please try again.

KZ.SEARCH_PROMPT: Search your configured metadata addon to choose a title.
KZ.NO_EPISODES: This source supplied no selectable numbered episodes.
KZ.REQUEST_FAILED: Request failed. Check your configuration and connection.
KZ.SOURCE_ERROR: This source failed; other results remain available.
KZ.SOURCE_INCOMPATIBLE: This source does not support the selected identity.
KZ.SPEED_CHART_SUMMARY: Download speed: {{current}} MiB/s now, peak {{peak}} MiB/s. Open connections: {{connections}} now, peak {{peakConnections}}.
KZ.ALLOCATION_FALLBACK: Allocation automatically switched to prealloc for filesystem compatibility.
KZ.ARIA2_STORAGE_FAILED: aria2 encountered a storage error. Check free space, folder permissions and the allocation mode.
KZ.ARIA2_SPEED_LIMIT: The download fell below the configured minimum speed. Check lowest-speed-limit in the transfer settings.
KZ.ARIA2_NETWORK_FAILED: The aria2 connection failed. Check the network, DNS and timeout in the transfer settings.
KZ.ADDON_HTTP_REQUIRED: This historical request requires torrent resolution. Select a new release with an HTTP link supplied by the search addon.
KZ.HTTP_LINK_FAILED: The HTTP link server refused or interrupted the transfer. Reload releases to obtain a current link and try again.
KZ.ARIA2_TRANSFER_FAILED: aria2 could not complete the transfer. Check the provider and try again.
KZ.DEBRID_CONCURRENCY: Concurrent downloads on the same debrid
KZ.DEBRID_CONCURRENCY_WARNING: Concurrent downloads on the same debrid may violate the provider's policy. Check your account limits before increasing this value.
KZ.CONNECTIONS_HELP: Sets max-connection-per-server and split to the same value, up to 16 connections.
KZ.LOWEST_SPEED_ENABLED: Require a minimum speed per connection
KZ.LOWEST_SPEED_ENABLED_HINT: Connections slower than the minimum are closed and are not replaced, so a download can end up with fewer connections.
KZ.SETUP_HELP: Configure metadata, at least one enabled search addon, a default debrid and writable storage. Jellyfin is optional.
KZ.MISSING_storage: Required: writable storage and valid naming settings
KZ.ADDON_HELP: Use the complete URL of a configured addon, such as AIOStreams, Torrentio or Comet, that provides HTTP download links. Secret URLs are hidden. Leave the URL blank to keep it when editing.
KZ.NEW_REQUESTS_ONLY: Changes affect new requests. Existing requests keep their naming snapshot and existing files stay in place.
KZ.PLACEHOLDERS: Available folder fields {title}, {year}, {season}, {episode}, {episodeTitle}, {providerId}. Bracketed segments are optional. {providerId} includes the identifier brackets. Use {season:02} for season padding.
KZ.SAMPLE_EXTENSION: This path uses illustrative metadata and an example original filename.
KZ.JELLYFIN_HELP: Configure Jellyfin libraries and mount the destination folders yourself. Only a server refresh is sent after final placement. Notification failure never repeats the download.
KZ.TOKEN_CONFIGURED: A token is saved. Leave blank to keep it.
KZ.WIZARD_INTRO: Connect your sources and choose where to keep your downloads.
KZ.STEP_HELP_metadata: Enter the manifest of the addon that supplies titles and episodes.
KZ.STEP_HELP_search: Configure sources in the order you want to query them.
KZ.STEP_HELP_storage: Add the destinations you want to use. Categories can share the same folder.
KZ.STEP_HELP_jellyfin: Enable library updates after downloads if desired. Finish to save the entire configuration.
KZ.ORIGINAL_FILENAME_HELP: The selected torrent file’s name and extension are preserved literally, including every release detail.
KZ.SETUP_INVALID: Review the indicated fields to finish setup.
KZ.INVALID_CONFIGURATION: Check these details and the availability of this integration or folder.
KZ.CONFIGURATION_CHANGED: Configuration changed in another session. Reload setup before trying again.
KZ.METADATA_EXAMPLES: We recommend AIOMetadata for titles, posters and episodes. Cinemeta is another option, with its manifest at https://v3-cinemeta.strem.io/manifest.json.
KZ.SEARCH_EXAMPLES: We recommend AIOStreams to bring your search sources together. Other examples include Torrentio and Comet. Paste the link generated after configuring the addon.
KZ.ADDON_NAME_HELP: Optional. Leave empty to use the name supplied by the manifest.
KZ.MANIFEST_URL_HELP: Paste the addon link, for example https://your-addon.example/your-configuration/manifest.json. stremio:// links are also supported. The /manifest.json suffix is added automatically.
KZ.ADDON_INVALID_URL: Enter a valid HTTP, HTTPS or stremio:// addon link.
KZ.ADDON_UNAVAILABLE: Could not connect to the addon. Check that its server is available and reachable from the backend.
KZ.ADDON_TIMEOUT: The addon took too long to respond. Try again or check its server.
KZ.ADDON_UNAUTHORIZED: The addon denied access. Generate a new link in its configuration and try again.
KZ.ADDON_NOT_FOUND: The manifest was not found. Check the link generated in the addon configuration.
KZ.ADDON_HTTP_ERROR: The addon server returned an error. Check its availability and try again.
KZ.ADDON_INVALID_MANIFEST: The link returned an invalid manifest. Copy the installation link generated by the addon.
KZ.ADDON_METADATA_INCOMPATIBLE: This addon must provide metadata and a searchable catalog. Use an addon such as AIOMetadata or Cinemeta.
KZ.ADDON_SEARCH_INCOMPATIBLE: This addon must provide movie, series or anime streams. Use an addon such as AIOStreams, Torrentio or Comet.
KZ.ADDON_SEARCH_REQUIRED: Add and enable at least one search addon.
KZ.STORAGE_CATEGORIES_HELP: Each category is optional. Movies, series and anime can share the same folder. Add only the destinations you want to use.
KZ.NO_CATEGORY_DESTINATIONS: No folder configured for this category.
KZ.DEFAULT_DESTINATION_HELP: This destination is selected when requesting a download in this category. You can choose another destination before downloading.
KZ.SERVER_DIRECTORY_HELP: Browse folders accessible to the DMDL server. In Docker, these paths refer to mounted volumes.
KZ.NO_SUBDIRECTORIES: This folder has no accessible subfolders.
KZ.DIRECTORY_UNAVAILABLE: Could not open this path. Enter an absolute directory accessible to the server.
KZ.CONFIGURE_CATEGORY_DESTINATION: Add a folder for this category in Settings to download.
KZ.RELEASE_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE: Select an enabled search addon in settings.
KZ.CANCEL_CLEANUP_PENDING: Download cancelled. Temporary-file cleanup will be retried. Check aria2 connectivity and folder permissions.
KZ.RELEASE_CONTEXT_INVALID: The title could not be identified. Go back to search and select it again.
KZ.STREAM_BADGES_HELP: Customize the quality, resolution, video, audio and language badges shown on releases.
KZ.STREAM_BADGES_IMPORT_HELP: Paste JSON containing filters and groups or imports. The first active import is used. Filters are stored as a local snapshot of sourceUrl. Paste a new JSON export to update them. To disable all badges, use {"imports":[]}.
KZ.BADGE_JSON_INVALID: Check the badge JSON. Use filters and groups or imports, with a name, valid regular expression and HTTP(S) URL for each image.
